title: By plot
dek: Each plot is a timeline of dated events. Watches are the ones still open. Charts stay the climate. A rhyme is not a cause. Unchanged is valid. Cancer stays open.

method.overlap_rule: Plot rooms are event timelines under canonical plotline/subplot pairs. A watch is one kind of event, still unresolved. Rooms do not own a climate, elect a season, or replace Pass 1s, the Aries weave, or Institutional Regime Waves.

rooms.dek: The rails: who clears, who holds the collateral, who may issue a private dollar, and who is allowed through the Gate. Lanes now hold the dated money record (gate-changing events only), not a news feed.
rooms.locked_question: Can a new dollar-body become a verifiable arrangement without the Gate opening, and without mistaking a test, a PDF, or a charter letter for operation?
